name: Canatara Park
note: Lake Huron beach, trails, pavilions, animal farm and miniature train. This prototype preserves mapped park geometry; attractions are research notes, not all modelled yet.

name: Centennial Park
note: Sarnia Bay waterfront park with gardens, walking paths, the Agora and marina access. Delivery handover is on a nearby street, not a licence to drive trucks onto park lawns.

name: Point Edward Waterfront
note: Point Edward is a separate village. Its waterfront looks across the St. Clair River toward Port Huron and up at the Blue Water Bridge. Shipping and bridge traffic shape the setting.

name: Blue Water Bridge
note: The north span has a cantilever truss; its south twin uses an arch structure. Both follow the supplied road alignments. Bridge elevations, dimensions and approach slopes are generated; the international crossing remains outside this prototype.

name: Sarnia City Hall
note: Municipal landmark at 255 Christina Street North. Mapped footprint and position; generated exterior and interior.

name: Sarnia Library
note: Mapped downtown library at 124 Christina Street South. The library is part of the downtown cultural cluster. Generated rooms are not its real floor plan.

name: Lawrence House
note: 127 Christina Street South: Queen Anne arts venue. Tower, bay and chimney cues follow municipal heritage research. OSM footprint 1526503538 is an inferred match from the documented corner; exterior proportions are stylized.

name: Germain Park
note: Recreation grounds with sports facilities, gardens, walking trails and the Golden Hawk memorial. The footprint is mapped; detailed attractions remain future work.

name: Lambton College
note: 1457 London Road. College and London Road corridor provide a distinct eastern destination. The marker is mapped; campus interiors are generated.

name: Wawanosh Wetlands
note: Mapped nature reserve. The nearby Nature Way offers wetland and woodland walking connections; only the paths present in this extract are represented.

name: Mitton Village
note: A distinct neighbourhood and commercial area recognized by the City community improvement plan. Fictional local residents and errands can give this district its own social life.

name: Bluewater Health
note: The hospital is mapped as a destination. It has a generated public interior, not an accurate hospital reconstruction; no clinical simulation is implemented.

name: Golden Hawk Memorial
note: Germain Park F-86 RCAF memorial, with metallic gold and red aircraft colours. Stylized original model; anchor from Veterans Affairs Canada memorial listing, not a new GIS dataset.
